confidence_notes: Holistic July 2026 estimates based on general knowledge of Nairobi’s urban dining and lodging costs. Accommodation prices vary substantially by neighborhood and service level. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price relationship to restaurant beer because direct local price knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Broadly comparable to other major East African capitals, with Nairobi’s larger business and tourism market supporting somewhat higher restaurant and accommodation prices.
